summary: gpredict 2.7+lab1: Gpredict v2.7 release tarball built with autotools without libgps and hamlib; lab patches fix rotctld_socket_rw, remove network TLE/transponder updates and refuse every radio type but RX only

patches.summary: rotctld_socket_rw: recv at most sizeout-1 bytes so the NUL stays inside the buffer (upstream wrote buffout[sizeout]), every negative send/recv return is an error, and an answer that fills the buffer is an error

no network element or transponder data: tle_update_from_network, modes_update_from_network and trsp_update_from_network return before any download; TLE AUTO_UPDATE_FREQ defaults to 0 (never) and the TLE SERVER/URLS and TRSP SERVER defaults are empty

radio_conf_read refuses every .rig whose Type is not 0 (RX only), so no uplink VFO is tuned and PTT is never set; SIGNAL_AOIQ/SIGNAL_LOIQ are never read and the 'U IQRECORD' commands of #371 are removed from check_aos_los

packages.name: gpredict
packages.description: Gpredict satellite tracking, receive-only SR-RX lab build (RX only radios, no network updates)

drop.reason: bundled satellites.dat and *.cat (element sets of 2026-11-01 and upstream categories): Gpredict loads only the satdata the srrx Gpredict bridge writes from labd's OMM (software/srrx/gpredict_bridge.py, build/15 W2 SW-GPREDICT); without bridge files first-time check step 5 fails and Gpredict does not start

notes: Source: the v2.7 release asset gpredict-2.7.tar.bz2 (sources.lock.json gpredict, tag v2.7 = commit 22593781), make dist output with the generated configure; nothing regenerates configure (no autoreconf, build/15 W2 SW-BUILDER). --disable-maintainer-mode keeps the Makefile rules from rerunning automake/autoconf even though intltool's Depends bring automake into the chroot.

configure.ac of v2.7 has no hamlib option at all (rig and rotator control are rigctld/rotctld TCP clients) and links libgps only when pkg-config finds libgps >= 2.90: build_depends has no libgps-dev and no libhamlib-dev (build/07 section 2), and forbid_needed refuses libgps* and libhamlib* in DT_NEEDED of usr/bin/gpredict (selftest RX-10 checks the same on the device).

libcurl stays a configure requirement (pkg-config libcurl >= 7.19), but lab patch 0002 returns from every download function before curl is used, empties the TLE and transponder server defaults and makes TLE AUTO_UPDATE_FREQ default to 0 (never; src/sat-cfg.c:211, src/tle-update.h:40). The compiler drops the unreachable curl calls and the linker (--as-needed) the library: the first CI build (sr-rx-packages run 42411548268) gave usr/bin/gpredict no libcurl in DT_NEEDED, and forbid_needed libcurl* now keeps it so. forbid_strings proves the default CelesTrak, AMSAT and SatNOGS URLs are gone from the binary.

Lab patch 0003: Gpredict only reads RX only radios (radio_conf_read refuses Type != 0, src/radio-conf.h RIG_TYPE_RX = 0), so the TX only, half/full duplex and FT-817/857/897 toggle paths, including set_ptt ('T 1'), are never reached; the #371 IQ record signalling ('U IQRECORD 1/0' on AOS/LOS) is removed and SIGNAL_AOIQ/SIGNAL_LOIQ are ignored (forbid_strings IQRECORD).

Lab patch 0001 keeps the rotctld_socket_rw fix of build/07 section 19: v2.7 src/gtk-rot-ctrl.c:180 still read sizeout bytes and then wrote buffout[size] = '\0' (one byte past the 128-byte buffers of get_pos/set_pos).

The bundled satdata (satellites.dat, *.cat) is dropped: first-time check step 5 (src/first-time.c:610-640) copies it only when the user's satdata has no .sat or no .cat file; the bridge writes both, and without bridge files Gpredict exits at the first-time check instead of loading a stale list.

etc/skel/.config/Gpredict/gpredict.cfg ([TLE] AUTO_UPDATE_FREQ=0, empty URLS) and hwconf/SDRPP-RX.rig (Type=0, 127.0.0.1:4532, SDR++ rigctl_server, no AOS/LOS/IQ signals) are the defaults for new accounts and the files selftest RX-10 reads on the staged root; they are byte-equal to what software/srrx/gpredict_bridge.py writes (software/tests/test_gpredict_bridge.py). Existing accounts get their files from the bridge.

CI build only: the package is CI_BUILT_UNREVIEWED; the GUI is never started in CI (gtk_init needs a display). Doppler tracking against SDR++ rigctl_server on the Q6A and the Expert-GUI session stay device rows.
